welcome-body.before:
Welcome to the 2027 EHS Management Institute, and thank you for choosing to join us. We are delighted to bring together an exceptional group of senior Healthcare HR leaders and solution providers for three days of meaningful conversations, fresh perspectives, and valuable relationship-building opportunities.

In the coming weeks, we will guide you through three simple steps to help prepare for a successful program. Your Operations Lead, Tori Di Clemente, will be available throughout the process to provide support and ensure you are ready to make the most of your experience.
